I B VWKVH YHNIC @O M H C L C F K O H Y IV B WKVH ?WO>IHKHVA G!UA%GD DE-FE0031937 / 0007 2.2 Hook up with Other Utility Lines Apart from BF gas line tie-in work, a few utility lines like nitrogen, steam & natural gas will be laid along the identified corridor and shall be hooked up with respective lines in the plant. 2.3 Construction of Carbon Capture Plant with Piping Work This portion covers the construction of the main plant, including yard piping which may be subdivided into multiple segments as detailed below. 2.3.1 Yard Piping This part covers BF gas supply and return gas piping from the tie-in point to the entry point of the main plant zone, all utility piping of nitrogen, steam, and natural gas from the hook-up point with existing plant utilities up to various units in the main plant area through the identified route, which will be finalized during detail engineering stage, as per requisite pressure and flow. A portion of the yard BF Gas piping has been envisaged to be installed with the provision of structural steel bracket arrangement from the existing shop. To design and install this portion of piping, a proper health study must be conducted to know the residual load-carrying capacity of existing building columns. Based on the health study report, the requisite strengthening of columns shall be designed and erected before the erection of BF Gas pipes. The pipe-supporting towers and pipes shall be erected over civil foundations constructed at defined locations avoiding interference with the existing on/overground operating facilities.
